topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The transfer to a new department feels like stepping into a different light, one that refines the edges of my tasks with a gentle clarity. I find myself moving through the day with a new rhythm, almost as if the walls around me are whispering encouragement, shifting their hues to match the mood of the moment. Colleagues in this new space are like old friends not yet met, their laughter a familiar sound threading through the air. The work is different, but not daunting; each task is a new page in a story I’m eager to write. I carry my old self here, gently, but I’m also letting the new space reshape me, one moment at a time.
